note: activity bar navigation icons -- platform's own interface: explorer, search, source control, run and debug, extensions, accounts, settings
status bar -- platform's own interface controls and status indicators: host, problems, forwarded ports, notifications, editor mode, eol, encoding, indentation, selection, screen reader mode
action toolbars -- platform's own controls: tab close button, editor tab group actions (open preview, split horizontal, more actions), notification clear and configure buttons
